description: Attestation of a mission-surplus donation from the commercial vendor entity (etzhayyim.com) to the non-profit religious-corp (etzhayyim), per ADR-2605301036 (Mission-Funding Earned-Revenue Arm). The vendor is a SEPARATE commercial entity that commits its surplus to fund the mission; this record is the religious-corp-side counterpart to the on-chain TitheRouter.donate() call. The donation is titheable (90% recipient program / 10% Public Fund) and uses the existing `donation`/`grant` purpose (no new commercial enum — ADR-2605192115 §4 prohibits a commercial paid tier on the religious-corp substrate; only the DONATION ever touches it). AGGREGATE-ONLY: this record carries NO vendor-customer PII and NO line-item commercial books (toritate G10); only period-level surplus + donated amount + routing. Earned income is a non-profit MEANS, not a profit END — cash to adherents remains ≡0 (ADR-2605301020 N1).

vendorDid.description: DID of the commercial vendor entity (etzhayyim.com) making the donation. Distinct from the religious-corp; the vendor donates arm's-length like any donor.

period.description: Reporting period this surplus donation covers, e.g. 2027-Q1 or 2027-03. Aggregate over the period; never per-transaction or per-customer.

donatedAmountMicros.description: Amount donated to the religious-corp in USDC micros (6 decimals; 1 USDC = 1000000). Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900 (no float in Lexicons).

grossSurplusMicrosDisclosed.description: OPTIONAL, voluntarily disclosed vendor distributable surplus for the period in USDC micros, for transparency of the payout ratio (donatedAmountMicros / grossSurplusMicrosDisclosed). The vendor's internal commercial books are NOT published here; this single aggregate figure is disclosure-only.

purpose.description: Titheable donation purpose per ADR-2605192130. Restricted to `donation`/`grant`; NO external-commercial purpose is valid on the religious-corp substrate (ADR-2605192115 §4).

recipientProgram.description: OPTIONAL earmark for the 90% recipient leg. When set to a mission program (e.g. public-fund / liberation-ladder / an actor DID), the donation can route ~100% to the mission (90% earmarked program + 10% tithe both reaching the Public Fund). Free of customer PII.

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the TitheRouter.donate() call on Base L2. Prefix `0x`, lowercase. Anchors this record to the on-chain split.

splitTxHash.description: Optional hex tx hash of the Public Fund 10% split when it occurs as a follow-up tx (typically the same atomic TitheRouter tx as txHash).

councilPolicyRef.description: Optional AT URI of the Council-attested vendor payout-ratio + reserve policy record this donation complies with (ADR-2605301036 §6; policy artifact deferred to R1).
